scripts.build: tsc -b shared server && npm run build -w agent
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared server && tsc -p agent --noEmit && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -b shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.dev:agent: npm run build -w agent && node --env-file-if-exists=agent/.env agent/dist/print-agent.cjs
